@@U00106@@
Are you that “thing” that trembles at its very core at the sound of my voice, a terrified, fleeing, writhing worm?

@@U00108@@
Am I to yield to you, you flaming form? Here | am! 浮士德! Your equal!

@@U00110@@
In floods of life, In storms of action, In ebb and flow, In warp and weft, Birth and death, An eternal sea, A changing pattern, A glowing life: I weave at the whirring loom of Time The living clothes of the Deity.

@@U00112@@
Busy Spirit circling the wide world, how near I feel to you!

@@U00114@@
You are like the spirit your mind can grasp, not me.

@@U00115@@
(The SPIRIT vanishes. 浮士德 collapses.)

@@U00117@@
Not you? Who then? I? Created in God’s image? Not equal even to you?
translation:
@@U00106@@
你是那个一听到我的声音就从内心颤抖的“东西”吗？一条受惊、逃跑、扭动的蠕虫吗？

@@U00108@@
我要屈服于你吗，你这个燃烧的躯体？在这里 |是！ 浮士德！你们平等！

@@U00110@@
在生命的洪流中，在行动的风暴中，在潮起潮落中，在经纱和纬纱中，生与死，永恒的海洋，变化的图案，发光的生命：我在时间的呼呼织布机上编织神灵的活衣。

@@U00112@@
忙碌的灵魂在广阔的世界里盘旋，我感觉你离我有多近！

@@U00114@@
你就像你的心灵能够抓住的精神，而不是我。

@@U00115@@
（精神消失。浮士德崩溃。）

@@U00117@@
不是你吗？那么谁呢？我？是按照上帝的形象创造的吗？连你也不平等？
